To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have computed the light quark and heavy quark diffusion constants for flavor current in the high temperature non-critical holography model and found that they are in good agreement with those of the lattice QCD and the phenomenological AdS/CFT models.
we have obtained the light quark and heavy quark diffusion constants for a holographic QCD in the high temperature, chiral symmetric phase, by using three different methods.

we have obtained the quark diffusion constant from the spectral function for vector and scalar fluctuations on flavor probe branes in non-critical AdSCFT, and that the light and heavy quark diffusion constants in the non-critical holography are comparable.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the spectral function in the high temperature chiral symmetric phase of the non-critical holography.
the study of the properties of the QCD plasma at high temperature.
the study of holography and QCD.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the diffusion constant for the light quark flavor current is D-tilde = 1.4-1.5 T(-1).
there is a clear and unambiguous evidence of a nontrivial quark-gluon plasma phase transition in the QCD vacuum.
the diffusion constant is not a well defined concept in the context of the holographic model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we obtain the light quark diffusivity in the non-critical holography, which is a holographic model of strongly coupled QCD at finite temperature.
we have obtained the quark diffusion constants in a holographic QCD system.

we have obtained the spectral functions for vector, axial-vector and scalar modes in the non-critical holography and have extracted the diffusion constant using three different methods, which gives the same result.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the light quark diffusivity is not universal, i.e., it depends on the flavor current.
the non-critical AdSCFT model is a useful tool to investigate transport properties of QCD matter.
the non-critical holography can be a useful tool for studying quark dynamics in the high temperature QCD phase.
